NVIS  Home & alerts  ·  Executive area home  ·  Executive — estate & availability  ·  Utilisation, power & energy  ·  Estate completeness  ·  GPU health  ·  Tray roster  ·  Node deep-dive
This board owns: GPU utilisation, power, energy, GPU-hours and GPU memory.  —  Availability is on Executive; nameplate shortfall is on Estate Completeness; temperature, throttling and ECC/XID are on GPU health.

panels.description: The L2 for every aggregate on this board. Same selector and same $variables as the stats above. GPUs, Power draw, Energy, GPU-hours delivered, GPU-hours utilised, Idle GPU-hours, GPU memory in use and GPU memory free each sum exactly to the stat of the same name (column totals are shown in the footer). Mean utilisation, Mean power per GPU and Allocation efficiency are per-Scale-Unit ratios, so they are not additive — the stats above are the fleet-wide figures.
